title: Review artifacts in isolated reviewer context
narrative: Independent review must not reuse the producer's accumulated reasoning by default. Reviewers see the artifact and acceptance contract; disagreement is retained. Accepts inspiration requirement 10[^insp-r10].
implementation: `IndependentReviewTemplate` builds produce → isolated review_* → aggregate_reviews with omit_producer_reasoning and retain_disagreement.
validation: Kind `independent_review_template`. Soft expects isolated payload flags and two reviewers.
